pr.body:
## Result
Repair rc.16 scanner provenance comparison while preserving complete original reports and all release gates.

Current metadata-only installed candidate: `ec745a2045cdc3d5e48f6917a6ed8227c84d394d`, tree `2390e38d2c5ade29f11cf6656b8f0732cba2fe5a`, sole reviewed executable parent `689a34e3b70659984d537af5410977a4eaa77e77` / tree `b404541f60ef7a927e085299c7159864a15ff53f`. Only the two review metadata files change; executable source, three-slot binder and surrounding notes bytes remain exact.

The bounded verifier preserves only the exact observed index-free Config / CodeQL DataflowRole=step singleton on typed inline thread-flow location objects. Both originals are validated before mapping, including every property bag. Other nonempty taxa remain rejected. Complete original raw records, reversible tool/artifact reference transport, multiplicity, hashes, pointer/index/external guards and current telemetry remain intact. Original532 remains HOLD; its authentic annotations exposed the former blanket refusal. No historical approvals are transferred.

## Fresh reviewed-source evidence
All23 normal689workflow groups passed; all103 current checks are complete (97SUCCESS,6expected conditionalSKIP). Original hosted validation passed160/160 with0fail/skip. Independent exact-source review and configured review6296330899 are clear.

Fresh JavaScript: genuine39461253608:2 producer+collectorSUCCESS, complete201rules/45actualresults/79flows/2081locations/832extractions/all89required. New complete current-source review found35false positives+10nonsecurity quality,0caseHOLD, preserving every bounded limitation. Current45 raw hashes/order and changed query metadata are used. [Full receipt and all45cases](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGIJobsv0/tree/081cff8e1015430b92f575f2b79bcdfbd9dd8656/docs/release-evidence/ti-compatible-set-20261020/jobs-689a34e/javascript), [fresh review6297099570](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGIJobsv0/pull/4004#issuecomment-6297099570).

Fresh Python: genuine39461253659:1 producer+collectorSUCCESS,172rules/0results/no warning/error diagnostics/all8required currentPY sources; complete original references and actual ordered metadata retained. [Fresh review6296683983](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGIJobsv0/pull/4004#issuecomment-6296683983), [8136B independent receipt](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGIJobsv0/blob/9ead21fa1ade7c28f9b9295fe67156611cc9807c/docs/release-evidence/ti-compatible-set-20261020/jobs-689a34e/python/independent-review.json).

[All baseline checks](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGIJobsv0/blob/478b4fa28b984feeb2bafcfe5da3d786f4321d68/docs/release-evidence/ti-compatible-set-20261020/jobs-689a34e/complete-source-ci.json). The first JScollector failure and its single unchanged original-producer/dependent recovery are retained separately; its underlying cause is not established.

## Remaining qualification
Fresh full installed-candidate CI, independent installation review and configured review are now required before normal merge. Actual final-main processed CodeQL service capture, native gates, complete archive/API authentication, original publisher checks and immutable public asset verification remain mandatory. Static source/data review and syntax-only preparation did not execute project functions/tests/scanners or replace those gates.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Map the remaining validation failures**

When any string field validated by `text()` is malformed—for example a missing analysis `environment`, `created_at`, tool version, or GUID—the capture throws an `AssertionError` such as `Invalid CodeQL service environment`. None of those messages appears in this table and `AssertionError` has no typed fallback, so the newly added diagnostic reports only `UNCLASSIFIED` for several explicit validation failures and does not identify the failing check. Add closed codes for the finite `text()` messages (or a safe classifier covering them).

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

Addressed at331112216733854f8ece6936f9822a6f672481fe, retained byte-identically at currentc3e943189a00bffa2e4dda265c6bd010b4930944: all eight finite text() labels (analysis/raw tool version and GUID, key, category, environment and analysis time) now have fixed literal codes. The formatter prints neither the exception text nor remote data. The331 full configured review is clear, and fresh currentc3 review/CI remains required. This thread resolution addresses only the missing-code finding; it is not current-source scanner or release qualification.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Allow CodeQL's nonempty thread-flow taxa**

When a CodeQL report contains path-problem flows, its thread-flow locations can carry nonempty `taxa` such as the `Config` entries in the checked-in `fresh-codeql.zip`. Because `verifyScannerAnalysis` now calls `reindexScannerRun` for every report, this assertion rejects those valid reports before either original report can be compared; the existing real-SARIF test fails with `Unsupported scanner result or thread-flow taxa`. Preserve and validate these unindexed taxa rather than requiring the array to be empty.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->
